name: com.orkunmanap.runtime-transform-handles.demos
description: Optional, independently imported scenarios for Runtime Transform Handles.

samples.description: Full-featured demo: spawns its own targets and exercises every handle type, axis mask, space, snapping mode, multi-object grouping, auto-scaling, and the interaction event system through an on-screen control panel.
A resettable prop workshop with single-object tools, World/Local group movement and rotation, and shared-center uniform group scaling.
Arrange supplied wall and corner modules with horizontal grid movement and quarter-turn rotation.
Assemble a lamp with socket attachment, constrained hinges and subtree-preserving detach.
A single entry point for all imported demo scenes, with an optional UI Toolkit gallery.
